subject: Request to defer Redwood demo — product roadmap shift
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Asha Verma <asha@nomadic.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed demo — Redwood inference walkthrough (30–40m)

Hi Asha,

Thanks again for the time on Tuesday — great to hear more about Nomadic Health's roadmap. Would Nomadic be open to a focused 30–40 minute demo next week to walk through: runtime performance, multi-environment deployment (hosted → dedicated → private), and a short Q&A on security/compliance?

Proposed slots (all PT):
- Tue 11/2, 10:00–10:40
- Wed 11/3, 14:00–14:40
- Thu 11/4, 09:00–09:40

I've attached a 1-page agenda and a concise checklist so we can tailor the demo to the right stakeholders (redwood_demo_agenda.pdf). If none of those times work, share a couple of windows and I'll send an invite.

Also looping in Marissa (AM) and Dev (solutions engineer) so we can cover procurement and technical fit.

Best,

Camila Reyes
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

---
Attachment: redwood_demo_agenda.pdf (application/pdf, 120KB)
From: Asha Verma <asha@nomadic.health>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed demo — Redwood inference walkthrough (30–40m)

Hi Camila — thanks for the agenda and the flexible slots. I need to be upfront: we've just shifted our priorities for Q4 to focus on a core data platform migration and a big customer pilot. That means the LLM/inference effort is getting deprioritized internally and a few hiring slots we were depending on have been delayed. I also have back-to-back travel starting next week, so scheduling a demo for early November won't work on our side.

That said, we are still interested in Redwood as a potential partner — the product fit looks promising — but we need to push active evaluation out of Q4. Can we put Nomadic on a soft-defer? I propose we reconvene in early February (week of Feb 8) to reassess priorities. In the meantime: could you send a one-pager with a ballpark cost range for hosted vs. dedicated options and a short list of security artifacts (SOC 2 scope, data retention notes)? That will help our procurement and engineering leaders triage later.

Appreciate your understanding.

Thanks,
Asha Verma
Head of Product, Nomadic Health
asha@nomadic.health | (617) 555-0116

Subject: Fwd: Nomadic — deprioritizing LLM effort this quarter (FYI / nurture plan)

Marissa, Dev — forwarding Asha's note below. Key points: product team is reallocating to a data platform migration, hiring delays, and execs are focused on immediate pilot commitments. They asked to reconvene in early Feb.

Proposed internal next steps:
- Add Nomadic to a Q1 nurture cadence (check-in week of Feb 8).
- Share a one-pager covering hosted vs. dedicated TCO bands + high-level security artifacts (I can draft).
- Keep them on a waitlist for a short hands-on eval; offer hosted credits so they can self-serve when they are ready.
- Flag deal as low-velocity for AE metrics and set task for a 2/8 follow-up in HubSpot (DEAL-4591).

Dev — can you draft a 1-page security summary (SOC 2 scope, retention, KMS/HSM options)? Marissa — can you propose a light nurture email sequence (3 touches: Nov follow-up, Jan check-in, Feb re-engage)?

I'll wait to hear back and will send the one-pager to Asha once we have the security stub.

Thanks,
Camila

Hi Asha — thanks for the update and for flagging timing. I appreciate the clarity and totally understand the need to focus on your data migration and customer pilot.

We'll mark Nomadic as deferred for Q4 and set a calendar check-in for the week of Feb 8 (I can send a tentative hold for Feb 9–10 and we'll confirm in January). In the meantime I'm attaching a concise nurture one-pager that covers: cost banding (hosted vs dedicated), security highlights (SOC 2 scope, retention options, KMS integration), and a short list of next-step options when you're ready (hosted POC credits, dedicated pilot path).

If it's helpful, we're also happy to provide a 15-minute executive briefing for your leadership in January to help inform budgeting/procurement — no demo required until you're ready.

Would you prefer a brief Doc/slide pack or a single PDF? Happy to tailor — I attached the PDF for convenience (inference_nurture_plan.pdf).
